the radio material keeps its green paint

results.finalMessage:
The radio disappeared because of a typo in `materials/radio.material`. The `baseColor` output was set to `pain`, which isn't a parameter. The parameter is `paint`. The material couldn't compile, so the radio's `MeshRenderer` had nothing to draw with.

I changed `pain` to `paint`. `ara check` now reports 0 errors and 0 warnings across 4 files. I haven't looked at the game itself, so I haven't confirmed the radio shows up on the shelf.

results.finalMessage:
The workbench stopped rendering because its `MeshRenderer.layer` was `editor`. The MainCamera's culling mask only includes `default` and `props`, so the camera skipped it. I haven't run the game to confirm it now shows.

I set the layer to `default` in `levels/outpost.scene`, which matches every other mesh in the level. I didn't touch the camera.

I could have added `editor` to the camera's mask instead, but that would also render anything else on that layer, and you asked me to leave the camera alone.
